programs.desc: Joe Laurinaitis and Mike Hegstrand were two young men searching for direction when they crossed paths in suburban Minneapolis in the early 1980s. A chance opportunity led them to become one of pro wrestling's most legendary tag teams, "The Road Warriors," later known as "Legion of Doom." Their journey to fame was marked by loyalty, obstacles and the struggle between one man's family life and the other's battle with addiction.
